# ⬡ SynthForge — Enterprise Synthetic Data Platform

> Generate high-fidelity synthetic datasets that mirror your real data's statistical properties — without exposing any PII.

## Overview

SynthForge is a full-stack synthetic data generation platform built for enterprise use. It trains machine learning models on your real data and produces statistically equivalent synthetic datasets — preserving distributions, correlations, and categorical relationships, while generating zero real records.

**Use cases:**
- Share data across teams without exposing customer PII
- Augment training datasets for downstream ML models
- Test pipelines with realistic data in non-production environments
- Satisfy data residency and compliance requirements

---

## Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| **Structured Data — CTGAN** | Conditional Tabular GAN — handles mixed numeric + categorical columns |
| **Structured Data — TVAE** | Tabular Variational Autoencoder — faster, great for numeric-heavy datasets |
| **Unstructured Text — GPT-2** | Fine-tunes GPT-2 on your corpus, generates text matching vocabulary and style |
| **Statistical Quality Metrics** | KS test, KL divergence, JS divergence, correlation Frobenius norm per column |
| **Interactive Results Dashboard** | Distribution overlays, quality gauge, JS divergence chart, side-by-side data previews |
| **Job Monitor** | Real-time progress, live training logs, download results, delete jobs |
| **REST API** | FastAPI backend with async job management — integrates with any client |
| **Docker Compose** | One-command full-stack deployment |

## Quick Start — Local Development

### Prerequisites

- Python 3.11+
- Node.js 18+
- Git

### 1. Clone the repo

```bash
git clone https://github.com/deltaalphasigma/synthetic-data-generator.git
cd synthetic-data-generator
```

### 2. Set up Python environment

```bash
# Windows
py -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\pip install -e ".[dev]"

# macOS / Linux
python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

### 3. Start the API server

```bash
# Windows
.venv\Scripts\uvicorn synth_data_gen.api.server:app --reload --port 8000

# macOS / Linux
uvicorn synth_data_gen.api.server:app --reload --port 8000
```

API is live at **http://localhost:8000** · Swagger docs at **http://localhost:8000/docs**

### 4. Start the React frontend

```bash
cd frontend
npm install
npm run dev
```

Open **http://localhost:3000**

## API Reference

### Health check
```
GET /health
→ { "status": "ok" }
```

### Upload a file
```
POST /upload
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Body: file=<CSV | Excel | TXT>

→ { "file_id": "uuid", "filename": "...", "rows": 1000, "columns": 5 }
```

### Start a structured job
```
POST /jobs/structured
{
  "file_id":     "uuid",
  "filename":    "customers.csv",
  "model":       "ctgan",      // "ctgan" | "tvae"
  "epochs":      100,
  "num_samples": 1000
}
→ 201 { "job_id": "uuid" }
```

### Start an unstructured job
```
POST /jobs/unstructured
{
  "file_id":        "uuid",
  "filename":       "corpus.txt",
  "base_model":     "gpt2",    // "gpt2" | "gpt2-medium"
  "epochs":         3,
  "num_samples":    10,
  "max_new_tokens": 100
}
→ 201 { "job_id": "uuid" }
```

### Poll job status
```
GET /jobs/{job_id}
→ {
    "job_id":            "uuid",
    "status":            "running",   // queued | running | completed | failed
    "progress":          42,
    "log":               ["epoch 1/100...", "..."],
    "real_sample":       [...],       // first 500 rows of input
    "synthetic_sample":  [...],       // first 500 rows of output
    "metrics":           { ... },
    "duration_seconds":  87.4
  }
```

### Download result
```
GET /jobs/{job_id}/download  →  streams CSV (structured) or TXT (unstructured)
```

### List and delete
```
GET    /jobs              →  array of all jobs
DELETE /jobs/{job_id}     →  204 No Content
```

## Quality Metrics

### Structured Data (per column)

| Metric | Applies To | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **KS Statistic** | Numeric | Kolmogorov-Smirnov test statistic — lower = closer distributions |
| **KL Divergence** | Numeric | Kullback-Leibler divergence — lower = better |
| **JS Divergence** | Both | Jensen-Shannon divergence — **target ≤ 0.10** |
| **Mean Difference** | Numeric | Absolute difference in column means |
| **Frobenius Norm** | Dataset | Distance between real and synthetic correlation matrices |

### Unstructured Text

| Metric | Description |
|---|---|
| **Vocabulary Jaccard** | Token set overlap between real and synthetic corpora |
| **Bigram JS Divergence** | Bigram distribution similarity — target ≤ 0.30 |
| **Trigram JS Divergence** | Trigram distribution similarity |
| **Avg Word / Char Count** | Text length comparison between corpora |

## UI Pages

### Home
Landing page showing platform capabilities, how-it-works steps, and a live recent-jobs table pulled from the API.

### Structured Data Generator
Full end-to-end workflow in a single page:
1. **Drag-and-drop upload** — CSV or Excel, parsed in-browser for instant preview
2. **Column analysis** — auto-detects numeric, categorical, and date columns
3. **Model selection** — interactive CTGAN vs TVAE cards with descriptions
4. **Parameter sliders** — epochs (10–500) and output row count (100–10,000)
5. **Live progress** — animated gradient progress bar with streaming training log
6. **Results dashboard:**
   - 4 KPI metric cards (rows, columns, quality score, training time)
   - Per-column distribution histogram overlay (real = blue, synthetic = orange)
   - SVG quality score gauge with sub-score progress bars
   - JS divergence bar chart with 0.10 threshold line
   - Full statistical metrics table with pass/fail badges
   - Side-by-side real vs synthetic data previews
   - One-click CSV download

### Text Generator
1. Upload `.txt` corpus (one sentence or document per line)
2. Configure GPT-2 model, fine-tune epochs, generation count, max tokens
3. Animated progress with live training log
4. Side-by-side real vs synthetic text cards
5. Vocabulary size and n-gram JS divergence charts
6. One-click TXT download

### Job Monitor
- Live sortable table of all jobs with status badges and mini progress bars
- Click any row to open a detail panel showing: full job ID, parameters grid, animated progress bar, expandable logs, error display
- Download button (completed jobs) and delete button

---

## Running Tests

```bash
# Activate venv first, then from project root:
pytest tests/ -v
```

Test coverage includes:
- CTGAN and TVAE fit + sample on small synthetic data
- KS test, KL divergence, JS divergence correctness
- Edge cases: non-overlapping distributions, category dtype inputs
- LLM text generator fit + generate
- Vocabulary overlap and n-gram metrics

---

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `VITE_API_URL` | `http://localhost:8000` | API base URL used by the React app |
| `UPLOAD_DIR` | `./data_store/uploads` | Directory for uploaded training files |
| `OUTPUT_DIR` | `./data_store/outputs` | Directory for generated output files |

Set `VITE_API_URL` at build time when deploying to a remote server:
```bash
VITE_API_URL=https://api.yourcompany.com docker compose up --build
```
